note.title: Education and work
note.specFocus: School subjects, timetables, rules, teachers, exams, homework, plans after school, careers, part-time jobs, work experience, and future ambitions.
note.sourcePages: Original GCSE Spanish revision material; it is not an official AQA paper, mark scheme, or copied publisher content.
note.summary:
Education and work

Key vocabulary
- las asignaturas; aprobar/suspender; las normas; los deberes; el horario; la carrera; el sueldo; las prácticas laborales; solicitar empleo; a tiempo parcial; el jefe; la universidad; tener éxito

Key grammar
- Use me gusta(n) with a singular or plural subject. Use hay que/tener que for obligation, the preterite for completed school events, the imperfect for primary-school routines, and future/conditional for ambitions.

Exam tips
- Use aprobar (to pass) rather than pasar. Do not confuse la carrera with un empleo. In translations, keep job nouns gender-appropriate and omit the article after ser where normal.

questions.modelAnswer:
1. My favourite subject is art because I can express my ideas.
2. School starts at half past eight and finishes at three.
3. At primary school we did not have homework on Fridays.
questions.question:
Listening-style written practice (read the transcript; there is no audio):

Lucía dice: «Mi asignatura favorita es el dibujo porque puedo expresar mis ideas. El instituto empieza a las ocho y media y termina a las tres. En la escuela primaria no teníamos deberes los viernes.»

Answer in English.
1. What does Lucía say about the first topic?
2. What extra detail is given in the second statement?
3. What is the main idea of the final statement?
